Information

NOM — Nature, Object, Mater. An architectural perspective shaped by the landscape, the things we make, and the materials we live with.

This collection explores homes, shared spaces, and interiors through a common language of light, proportion, and texture.

Areas of focus

  • Residential architecture
  • Cultural spaces
  • Interiors
  • Material exploration

Our perspective

  • Nature as a starting point
  • Objects with purpose
  • Materials with presence
